about_the_game:
About This Game

Myth Guardians is a strategic tower defense game with charming pixel art graphics. Players must borrow the power of angels and mythological gods to stop the encroaching demonic legion.

Legendary gods appear as towers, which you can place, enhance, and merge to create powerful synergistic combinations. Defend each lane through tactical placement and skillful use of abilities to fend off the demonic invasion. Ultimately, you will face off against the demon lords of the Seven Deadly Sins.

Features

  • Mythological Defense in Pixel Art

    • Gods from various mythologies such as Olympus, Angels, Egypt, and Norse mythology appear as towers.

  • Enhance & Merge System

    • Upgrade and merge towers to evolve them into even more powerful gods.

  • Synergistic Strategy

    • Combine synergies based on mythological themes to create diverse deck strategies.

  • Epic Boss Battles

    • Engage in fierce battles with the demon lords of the Seven Deadly Sins, and encounter the Four Perils in a special mission mode.

[Content Available in This Demo]

  • Play Modes: Experience the tutorial to learn the game's basics, plus the main mode available in two difficulties (Easy and Normal).

  • Enemies to Face: Battle against 4 of the Great Demons of the Seven Deadly Sins, their unique waves of monsters, and legions of sub-bosses. You can also get a sneak peek at the special mission boss, the Four Perils.

  • Available Units: Use units from a selection of mythological themes, including Olympus, Animal, Hero, Taegeuk, and more.

  • Unit Tiers: Test your strategies by combining units from Common to Epic tiers, along with a special selection of Legendary and Angel units.
